symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The volume, the total number of bits of the T coefficients of p bits each, Tp = Theta(n).
symbols.quote: Let $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$ be the volume of $T$ coefficients of $p$ bits.

symbols.name: margin
symbols.meaning: The margin below one of the i-th dominant normalized cost, a positive number with that cost equal to p^{1-g_i}.
symbols.quote: Each is a power $p^{1-g_i}$, where $g_i>0$ is its margin below one.

symbols.name: visit exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that there are at most p^A setup visits in the recursions.
symbols.quote: The recursions have constant branching and depth $O(\log p)$, so fix exponents $A$ and $C$ with at most $p^A$ visits, each with setup of at most $p^C$ steps.

symbols.name: setup exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that the setup of one visit takes at most p^C steps.
symbols.quote: The recursions have constant branching and depth $O(\log p)$, so fix exponents $A$ and $C$ with at most $p^A$ visits, each with setup of at most $p^C$ steps.

relations.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md).
Each of at most $\ell$ rounds costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ by [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md).

Exceptional addresses, where the packed shifts of [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md) fail, are a fraction $O(d2^{-K})$ of addresses, repaired by sorting a compact stream, cost $O(Vp^{O(1)}2^{-K})=o(V)$, since $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$ beats any power of $p$.

derivations.quote: Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate. Each is a power $p^{1-g_i}$, where $g_i>0$ is its margin below one.
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md). The total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
The recursions have constant branching and depth $O(\log p)$, so fix exponents $A$ and $C$ with at most $p^A$ visits, each with setup of at most $p^C$ steps.
Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, and any fixed power of $\log p$ is at most $p^\kappa$ eventually.
